posts.author: meowmeowmeow
posts.body:
Hii! I'm pretty new to using RPG Maker MZ and just started testing and making a project a week ago. Everything has been going well until today, when suddenly the playtest audio stops working
I've tried:
- changing and resetting my laptop's sound mixer
- restarting my computer
- restarting and disconnecting my headphones
- changing the input and output on my laptop
- restarting RPGMZ
- double checked all the volume settings in the program and they all seem fine to me.
- went to the audio settings during playtest and made sure it was at 100%
- pressed F6 during playtest (because I have plugins installed) and that didn't do anything
When I deployed the game the audio works , and when I made another project in RPGMZ the playtest audio works there as well... So I guess the issue is only with this specific project's playtest?? I'm at a lost for what to do. I really have no clue what I did to cause this and it would be nice to be able to playtest my game's audios without having the deploy it every time. Help would be appreciated <3
I don't think it's a problem with my plugins because I've tried playtesting without any of them active, but here is the list anyways:
VisuMZ- Core Engine
VisuMZ- MessageCore
VisuMZ- AniMsgTextEffects
VisuMZ- Doodads System and Doodads Editor
Gabe- GabeMZ_StepSound
SCSWinter- MultiTweaks

posts.author: ShadowDragon
posts.body:
if your laptop has realtek sound or USB pearing, check the speaker
or test a youtube video (sound from software and video plays from the
same device).
if no sound there too, check speaker from USB to realtek or vice versa.
check if options in playtest if it's has 100% or if master volume is added
if that is on 100% and no 0%.
